title: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
summary: OpenShell is an open‑source runtime that isolates autonomous AI agents, offering sandboxed execution, resource limits, and private data handling for fleets. It integrates with NVIDIA’s AI stack and provides APIs for safe agent orchestration.
